name: OpenSparrow
description: OpenSparrow is an open-source, self-hosted platform designed to create internal systems, CRUD applications, admin dashboards, and calendars in minutes. Driven by a philosophy of absolute simplicity, the platform is schema-driven (generating forms and tables from configuration files) and features zero external dependencies. It is written entirely in native PHP and vanilla JavaScript, backed by a PostgreSQL database, making it extremely lightweight, fast, and secure.
